modules.module_title: Prepare for routine service, maintenance and minor repairs

pcs.pc_description: review the job card and understand the work to be carried out
identify the auto component manufacturer specifications related to various components/aggregates in the vehicle
inspect the components requiring replacement due to continuous wear and tear such as chain and chain sprocket, clutch cable, brake linings and pads etc.
inspect the machining/repair done by outside source/local machining garages
test ride the two wheeler vehicle to assess the requirement of calibration, other adjustments and repairs if any, in the electrical/mechanical aggregates
use checklist for confirming routine servicing tasks and coordinate with superior for non-routine service or repair, if any
collect workshop tools/equipment, spare parts and appropriate grade of lubricants, oils and grease required for the job

modules.module_title: Perform routine service, maintenance and minor repairs

pcs.pc_description: take precautions to avoid damage to the vehicle and its components while working on various aggregates
check lubricants/fluids level and refill/top-up if required,
use relevant computer based applications to find faults in the electronic system of engine, brake and other aggregates

check for any repair requirements observed in the components/aggregates and systems (such as engine, gearbox etc.) while repairing/overhauling of braking or suspension systems and report the same to supervisor/service advisor for further inspection by other specialists
remove, replace, and repair relevant parts in various aggregate of the vehicle as per OEM Standard Operating Procedure
clean and condition dismantled parts/components, prior to reassembly
ensure completeness of tasks assigned before releasing the vehicle for the next procedure
maintain the documentation related to inspection, servicing, maintenance and repair of the vehicle
check the performance of vehicle/aggregate post repair and report to supervisor/service advisor if further inspection is required by another specialist
dispose off materials such as waste oil, scrap of failed parts/aggregates, as per organization’s policies
return leftover consumable/parts, tools/equipment, and report if any malfunctions are observed to the person concerned
perform scheduled checks, calibration and timely repairs for workshop tools, equipment and workstations

modules.module_title: Prepare for Electrical and Electronics Service

pcs.pc_description: Review job card and customer complaints related to electrical or electronics issues
Gather necessary hand tools, testing meters, wiring diagrams, and OEM manuals before starting work.
Inspect the condition of wiring harnesses, connectors, and electrical system visually for faults or damage

modules.module_title: Conduct Minor Electrical Fault Diagnosis and Repairs

pcs.pc_description: Test battery voltage, specific gravity (for lead-acid) or health indication (for VRLA/Li-ion) as per OEM standards
Replace defective headlamps, tail lamps, indicator bulbs, number plate bulbs, and brake lamps as per wiring diagram
Inspect and replace blown fuses with OEM recommended rated fuses ensuring no bypassing
Check operation of switches (starter, brake light, indicator, horn) and repair/replace as needed.
Repair minor open circuits, loose connectors, or corroded terminals as per standard practices

modules.module_title: Inspect and Handle Basic Electronics Components

pcs.pc_description: Perform basic On-Board Diagnostics (OBD) code reading using handheld scanner for engine check lights, if applicable.
Inspect basic sensors (speed sensor, throttle position sensor, ABS sensor) for connectivity and mounting conditions
Perform simple resets (throttle reset, immobilizer reset) where instructed in OEM manual
Verify corrected operations by switching on lights, indicators, horn, start switch, and dashboard displays
Clear any error codes post repair using appropriate tools or report unresolved issues to supervisor.
Complete repair records, battery service log, and parts replacement list properly on job card.
Return the vehicle in clean condition ensuring all electric functions work normally after service.

pcs.pc_description: Review job card details and customer complaints related to mechanical faults in three- wheelers
Collect required tools, lifting equipment, service manuals, and personal protective equipment before commencing work
Inspect three-wheeler condition externally for signs of mechanical wear, oil leakages, and physical damages

modules.module_title: Perform Clutch and Brake System Repairs

pcs.pc_description: Inspect clutch pedal free play, clutch cable, and adjust or replace as per OEM recommendations
Dismantle and replace worn-out clutch plates, pressure plates, or release bearings as per SOPs.
Inspect brake linkages, rods, drums, liners, and adjust or replace defective parts to restore braking efficiency

modules.module_title: Repair Propeller Shaft and Differential Components

pcs.pc_description: Inspect propeller shaft universal joints for wear and play; lubricate or replace if necessary
Inspect differential housing for oil leaks, unusual noise, and backlash; report major faults to supervisor.
Replace differential oil, adjust backlash if applicable, and ensure proper tightening torque as per OEM standards
Inspect leaf springs, shackle pins, bushes, and U-bolts for wear and looseness; replace if defective
Check operation of shock absorbers; replace leaking or ineffective dampers following OEM SOPs
Conduct final torque tightening of critical fasteners like propeller shaft bolts, suspension U- bolts
Perform test drive to verify clutch engagement, braking effectiveness, and suspension ride quality post-repair
Complete service record documentation including repairs performed, parts replaced, and customer feedback collection
